description: Replace StubTranscriber in internal/ingest/transcribe.go with a real implementation. StubTranscriber currently returns an empty TranscriptResult for any audio file. A real implementation must: call an ASR service (OpenAI Whisper, AssemblyAI, AWS Transcribe, or local Whisper) with the uploaded audio file path; return speaker-diarized TranscriptSegment slices with SpeakerID, StartMs, EndMs, and Text; handle audio format conversion if needed; propagate API errors cleanly. The Transcriber interface is already defined and wired into upload_handler.go.
title: Implement real ASR transcriber (Whisper/AssemblyAI)

description: Replace StubEmbedder in internal/ingest/embed.go with a real embedding model. StubEmbedder generates deterministic pseudo-random 64-dim vectors — semantically meaningless. A real implementation must: call an embedding API (Qwen3-embedding per AGENTS.md architecture, or OpenAI text-embedding-3-small as fallback); return properly L2-normalized float32 vectors; support both Embed(string) and EmbedBatch([]string) for efficiency; handle API errors and rate limits. Embedder is wired into both the Chunker (for storing chunk vectors) and HybridIndex (for query-time vector search). Vector dimensionality must be consistent between indexing and query time.
title: Implement real text embedder (Qwen3/OpenAI)

description: Before implementing the Python and Go changes, pin down the exact byte layout for the new binary embedding file format (.fembed). Draft includes: 16-byte header (magic FEMB, version uint16, dims uint16, record_count uint32, 4 reserved bytes) and per-record layout (source_file_len uint32, source_file UTF-8, start_token int32, text_len uint32, text UTF-8, embedding float32 LE array). Review against: Python struct.pack compatibility, Go binary.Read compatibility, forward extensibility (version field), and whether start_token should be preserved or replaced with byte offsets. Output: a finalized spec (comment block or doc) that both python/embed.py and internal/ingest/embedfile/reader.go will implement against.
title: Spec out binary .fembed file format

description: Replace StubStitcher in internal/stitch/stub.go with a real PromptStitcher that uses an LLM (Claude) to generate minimal glue text between transcript chunks. StubStitcher currently joins chunks with a literal ' ... ' ellipsis. A real implementation must: accept ordered []Chunk and a GlueLevel (0-100 int) indicating how much transitional prose to add; build a prompt instructing the LLM to produce only the glue spans between chunks, leaving chunk text verbatim; parse LLM JSON output into []Span with Kind=SpanChunk or SpanGlue and ChunkID attribution; map GlueLevel to prompt instructions (e.g. 0=bare join, 50=light transitions, 100=full narrative bridge); handle LLM errors gracefully. The Stitcher interface is already defined in stitch/stitch.go and wired into stitch_handler.go.
title: Implement LLM-powered stitcher (Claude)

description: search/cluster.go already has a complete LLMClusterer implementation (lines 185-278) alongside the EmbeddingClusterer fallback, but only EmbeddingClusterer is used. LLMClusterer groups chunks by semantic sub-theme using an LLM rather than pure vector distance. Task: decide where LLMClusterer should be selected vs EmbeddingClusterer (config flag, per-request param, or always-on); wire the chosen clusterer into the retrieval/search handlers; add any missing LLM client initialization in main.go. This is lower priority than the three primary stubs since EmbeddingClusterer is functional, just less semantically aware.
title: Wire LLMClusterer into search/retrieval pipeline
